truth_boundary: Pipeline discovery and declared leaf IDs are catalogue evidence only. Plumbing availability is not source execution, and there is no automatic execution of source capabilities. Machine Voice export is a state-contract handoff only and is not cross-repository runtime verification. The local Machine Voice composition runner becomes cross-repository runtime evidence only when executed against a real local/staged Machine Voice checkout; repository CI uses a fake external process and must not be called runtime verification. Invariant Lab packet import preserves external FAIL/HOLD evidence but does not prove Monolith behavior, verify or invalidate a pipeline, or grant authority. Connected packaging proves only explicitly required validated receipts. This manifest grants no automatic merge, CANON, installation, device, network, or risk authority.
